stem: Give scientific reason: While going from left to right within a period, the size of atom decreases.
solution: On going from left to right within a period, the atomic number increases by one at each step, so the nuclear charge (number of protons) increases while the new electrons are added to the same outermost shell (the number of shells stays the same). The increased nuclear charge pulls the electrons of the same shell more strongly towards the nucleus, so the atomic radius (size of the atom) decreases across a period.

stem: Give scientific reason: For electric power transmission, copper or aluminium wire is used.
solution: Copper and aluminium are used for electric power transmission because they are excellent conductors of electricity (very low electrical resistivity), they are highly ductile so they can be drawn into long thin wires, and they are relatively cheap and easily available. These properties allow current to be carried over long distances with least loss of energy.

stem: Give scientific reason: In some countries, ethanol is used as an additive to increase the efficiency of petrol.
solution: Ethanol is a clean fuel that burns almost completely. When it is added to petrol, the mixture burns more completely and efficiently, releasing more energy and producing fewer harmful pollutants (such as carbon monoxide and unburnt hydrocarbons). It also raises the octane rating of the fuel and saves petrol, so ethanol is used as an additive to increase the efficiency of petrol.

stem: Name and state the principle used to measure the specific heat capacity of a substance.
solution: The principle of heat exchange (method of mixtures) is used. Principle: when a hot body and a cold body are placed in thermal contact, heat flows from the body at higher temperature to the body at lower temperature until both attain a common (equal) temperature; assuming no heat is lost to the surroundings, the heat energy lost by the hot body is equal to the heat energy gained by the cold body (heat lost = heat gained).

stem: What is done to prevent rusting of iron door of your house?
solution: Rusting is prevented by not allowing the iron surface to come in contact with air and moisture. The iron door is coated with a protective layer, e.g. by painting it, applying grease/oil, galvanising (coating with a layer of zinc) or electroplating. Painting the door is the common everyday method used at home.

Distinction between mass and weight:

| Mass | Weight |
| --- | --- |
| It is the amount (quantity) of matter contained in a body. | It is the force with which the earth attracts the body. |
| It is a scalar quantity. | It is a vector quantity. |
| Its SI unit is the kilogram (kg). | Its SI unit is the newton (N). |
| It remains constant everywhere. | It changes from place to place with the value of \(g\). |
| It is measured with a beam balance. | It is measured with a spring balance. |
| Represented as \(m\). | Given by \(W = mg\). |

stem: The 'rocket' is a type of fire cracker used in Diwali. (a) Name the launcher. (b) Name the law on which its working is based.
solution:
(a) The launcher of the fire-cracker 'rocket' is a bottle (a glass or plastic bottle in which the rocket is stood upright before it is lighted).
(b) Its working is based on Newton's third law of motion (the law of action and reaction): the hot gases are thrown out backward/downward and the equal and opposite reaction pushes the rocket forward/upward. This is equivalently explained by the law of conservation of momentum.

stem: What is meant by decomposition reaction? Write the chemical reaction of decomposition of sugar on heating.
solution:
A decomposition reaction is a reaction in which a single compound breaks down into two or more simpler substances, usually on being supplied energy in the form of heat, light or electricity.
Decomposition of sugar on heating: \(C_{12}H_{22}O_{11} \xrightarrow{\Delta} 12C + 11H_2O\). On heating, sugar decomposes into carbon (a black residue) and water vapour.
